sloka: हीनार्थः सुसमृद्धार्थं को रिपुं प्राकृतं यथा।निश्चित्य जीवितत्यागे वशमानेतुमिच्छति ।। ६.६४.१७ ।।
transliteration: hīnārthaḥ susamṛddhārthaṁ ko ripuṁ prākṛtaṁ yathā।niścitya jīvitatyāge vaśamānetumicchati ।। 6.64.17 ।।

translations.english: "How can a weak person desire to go to the enemy who is rich in resources, determined to sacrifice his life several times and submit himself?"
